**Finding resubmitted: Compliant** — no redline, no comment.

**Basis (unchanged, now with the false-signal explained):**

| Provision | Direction |
|---|---|
| § 6 (p0047) — documentation supporting charges, right to contest | Favours us |
| § 3(e) (p0037) — real-time access to usage statistics and raw log files | Runs to Client, not TrueLink |
| § 8 (p0051–p0056) — Client covenants | Compliance/access-restriction/content warranties only; no inspection right |
| § 8(f) (p0058) — technical measures against spamming | Vendor self-help on vendor's own platform; not an audit; no access to our systems |
| § 9 (p0060) — access for Y2K repairs at TrueLink's sole cost | Favours us |

Searches for "audit," "inspect," "records," "verif" and "monitor" returned no hits, so there is no audit, inspection or verification right binding Mortgage Logic.com.

**On the failed check:** the deterministic "audit frequency limited" test could not match because there is no audit clause to constrain — absence of the pattern here reflects absence of the risk, not a deviation. Silence is better for us than the preferred position, so the correct output is no edit.

**Carry-forward for negotiation:** resist any audit right TrueLink proposes; if one must be conceded, hold to once per 12 months, 30 days' written notice, business hours, independent auditor bound by confidentiality, TrueLink's cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, and no access to our systems — falling back to annual on 15 days' notice with a 10% underpayment threshold only if needed.
